description: Deep research in one call, no LLM: a deep search of the question, its sub-topics (or your sub_queries) as searches of their own, and the pages its list and index results link to, returned as one cited report: summary, key facts, a section per sub-topic and the sources, every passage quoted verbatim with [n]. Costs 1 credit. For a quick evidence pack use contextfetch_research.

num_results_per_query.description: Results per sub-query (1-25, default 5; at most 10 are used).

sub_queries.description: Up to 3 search queries covering different angles of the question. Strongly recommended.

name: contextfetch_deep_research
